fact: Geeska Freedom Centre documented the arrest of 13 people, three journalists and ten social media users, by police and NISA in Mogadishu over six weeks to July 2026 for critical content, including the 30 June 2026 disappearance of Xogbile founder Mascuud Warsame.
title: Escalating crackdown on freedom of expression in Somalia as journalists and social media users arbitrarily detained
